name: serangkai-b2
description: Deploy Serangkai to Cloudflare Workers with D1 and Backblaze B2 (no R2).

ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Owner login name for this Serangkai instance.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Owner password. Choose a strong value; it is stored as a scrypt hash.

JWT_SECRET.description: Stable root secret for browser sessions. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

SHARE_SECRET.description: Different stable secret for signed share links. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

NUXT_APP_SECRET.description: Stable session-sealing key for Workers. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`; it must not change between deploys.

S3_ENDPOINT.description: Backblaze B2 S3 endpoint, for example `https://s3.us-west-004.backblazeb2.com`. Find it under your bucket's details.

S3_REGION.description: The B2 region from the endpoint, for example `us-west-004`.

S3_BUCKET.description: The private B2 bucket name. Keep the bucket private; do not enable public access.

S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: B2 application key ID, scoped to the bucket. Do not use the account master key.

S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: The application key. It is shown once by Backblaze when created.
